#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
    }

    string next() {
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        return s;
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        if (cin.peek() != EOF) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader sc;
    string s = sc.next();
    int ans = 0;
    int r = s.length();
    while (r > 0) {
        int l = r - 1;
        while (l >= 0 && s[l] == s[r - 1]) {
            --l;
        }
        if (((r - l - 1) & 1) == 0) {
            ++ans;
        }
        r = l + 1;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
